title: 2027 Prairie becomes a brick villa with its bays
items: 2027 Prairie, the house linked to the Cobb family, is no longer a rough placeholder. It now follows the 1911 fire-insurance map: a brick house of two and a half storeys whose front pushes forward in a tall bay, with a three-sided bay on its north side, an open stoop at the south corner, a two-storey range behind and a dormer in its hipped roof. No photograph of the house is known, so its windows, trim and colours are a careful, labelled guess.
